items.headline: Iranian Rial Plunges to Record Low as U.S. Tightens Sanctions and Diplomatic Push Continues
items.summary: On Tuesday, Iran's currency dropped to a historic low of over 2.5 million rials per U.S. dollar amid mounting regional tensions and severe economic pressure. The sharp devaluation coincided with new U.S. Treasury sanctions targeting Iranian military supply networks, even as international mediators attempt to broker diplomatic negotiations between Washington and Tehran.

items.headline: White House and Top Tech Executives Sign Voluntary AI Safety Accord
items.summary: On September 29, 2026, U.S. President Donald Trump hosted executives from major technology companies—including Google, Meta, Nvidia, and OpenAI—at the White House to sign a voluntary AI safety agreement. The accord establishes shared principles and internal safeguards for developing advanced artificial intelligence amid growing global debates over tech regulation.

items.headline: U.S. Senate Passes Landmark Protect College Sports Act
items.summary: The United States Senate passed the landmark Protect College Sports Act by a bipartisan 77-22 vote, establishing a historic federal framework for college athlete compensation and transfer policies. This sweeping legislation now moves to the House of Representatives as Congress attempts to standardize rules across collegiate athletics.

items.headline: Warner Bros. Schedules 'Game of Thrones: Aegon's Conquest' Movie for June 2029
items.summary: Warner Bros. has officially scheduled 'Game of Thrones: Aegon's Conquest' for a theatrical release on June 1, 2029. Directed by Owen Harris from a screenplay by Beau Willimon, the project marks the iconic fantasy franchise's first feature film.
